stemMd: Four distinct books are arranged on a shelf. How many orders are possible?
explanationMd: There are four choices for the first position, then three, two and one. Multiplication gives 4!=24. The books are distinct and each is used once.

distractorRationale.a: This counts choices for only the first position.
distractorRationale.d: This treats every position as if books could repeat and uses an incomplete power count.
distractorRationale.c: This counts only two successive choices.
distractorRationale.b: This does not account for all permutations.
